author: Eva Petrova

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Equilibrate all reagents to room temperature (RT) and mix each properly before use.

steps.title: Prepare Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the master mix based on the number of samples and vortex for several seconds. Transfer 20 µL of ddPCR™ Supermix for Probes (No dUTP, Bio-Rad #1863023) into each well of a 96-well plate (Bio-Rad #12001925).

substeps.instruction: Use a mechanical or electronic dispenser (e.g., Multipette, Pipettman, or multichannel pipette) to increase efficiency.

steps.title: Add DNA Samples
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of the examined DNA sample into each well.

steps.title: Seal and Mix Plate
steps.instruction: Seal the plate using pierceable aluminium foil (Bio-Rad #1814040) at 180°C for 5 seconds. Allow the foil to cool, then vortex the plate vigorously for 30 seconds to 1 minute.

steps.title: Generate Droplets
steps.instruction: Select sample positions on the touch screen and start droplet generation. After the process finishes, visually inspect the plate to ensure two separated phases are visible: an upper phase containing droplets and a lower clear oil phase.

steps.title: Seal and Transfer for PCR
steps.instruction: Remove the plate from the machine and immediately seal it with pierceable aluminium foil (Bio-Rad #1814040) at 170°C for 3 seconds. Transfer the sealed plate into the PCR cycler immediately, as droplets are unstable at this stage.

steps.title: Perform PCR Amplification
steps.instruction: Run the PCR cycler with a reaction volume of 40 µL and a ramp rate of 2°C/sec for each step using the following program:

substeps.instruction: 40 cycles of: 94°C for 30 seconds and 60°C for 2 minutes

steps.title: Post-PCR Inspection
steps.instruction: Check that two phases are still present and allow the plate to cool down to reduce droplet stickiness before analysis.

steps.title: Prepare Reader and Plate
steps.instruction: Switch on the QX200 reader 30 minutes before measurement. Place the plate into a metal holder and load it into the reader.

steps.title: Configure QuantaSoft Experiment

substeps.instruction: Define the position of each sample

steps.title: Maintain Reader Oil
steps.instruction: Check the reader oil and waste levels via the green control on the left side of the machine. If the instrument has not been used for more than a week, prime the machine (flush oil) first.

steps.title: Measure Droplets
steps.instruction: Start the measurement. Once finished, verify that the total droplet count per sample is above 12,000 (typically 18,000 - 20,000) for reliable results.

steps.title: Analyze Data and Set Threshold
steps.instruction: Set the threshold just above the negative control (NTC) sample to distinguish positive droplets (containing PCR products) from negative droplets. The software will calculate the copy number using the Poisson distribution algorithm.

steps.title: Calculate Final Concentration
steps.instruction: Export the .csv file containing concentrations (copies/µL). Calculate the number of copies in 1 µL of input DNA using the formula: (concentration value x 22) / volume of DNA.
